findings.title: Hero content panel lacks the dark rounded panel card
findings.reference: The reference hero presents the brand pill, three-line H1, two short paragraph lines and the CTA inside a distinctly darker rounded panel (#2A2150 ~85% opacity, radius 16px) that visibly separates the content block from the photographic background.
findings.candidate: The candidate hero places the brand chip, H1, two paragraph lines and the CTA directly on the photo overlay without a discrete rounded content panel, so the hero silhouette reads flatter and less layered than the reference.
findings.direction: In the home (and inner-page) hero, wrap the brand pill + H1 + paragraphs + CTA + availability badge in a rounded 16px panel with bg #2A2150 at ~85% opacity and 36px padding, max-width ~520px, left-aligned over the photo overlay.

findings.title: Logo marquee band below hero is missing
findings.reference: Directly beneath the hero the reference shows a slim violet client-logo band with scrolling grayscale wordmarks (~64px tall) separating the hero from the about band.
findings.candidate: The candidate goes straight from the hero badge into the About section with no logo marquee band, removing a distinct strip from the page silhouette.
findings.direction: Insert a slim violet #6D28D9 band (≤64px) directly under the hero with a hover-pausable marquee of grayscale text wordmarks (duplicated track for seamless loop); under reduced motion render a static single row.

findings.title: Floating metric cards on the Why Us photo tile are missing
findings.reference: In the Why Us split the right photo tile carries two overlapping white metric cards (small icon chip, gray label like 'Receita Mensal', big bold 800 value) anchored top-right and bottom-left over the image.
findings.candidate: The why-us photo tile is clean, with the stat card content instead placed in a separate white panel at the bottom-left of the tile; no floating overlapping metric cards.
findings.direction: Anchor two white radius-16px metric cards over the why-us photo tile (top-right and bottom-left offsets), each with a 64px icon chip, 12px #8B84A3 label and 28px 800 #1A1333 value; remove the separate stat panel.

findings.title: Services grid is missing the full-width horizontal split card
findings.reference: The reference services collection includes a full-width horizontal split card (icon left, title + description right) among the card rows, varying the grid rhythm.
findings.candidate: The candidate renders the services collection as an even 4×3 grid of uniform cards with no full-width split card, making the rhythm more repetitive than the reference.
findings.direction: Move one flagship offering into a full-width horizontal split card (lilac icon tile ~96px left, title/body + solid violet 'Talk to a Strategist' pill right) after the first card row, keeping the remaining cards in rows of four.

findings.title: Testimonial star rows are gold rather than neutral
findings.reference: Reference testimonial cards show gold/orange star rows on the white quote cards over the duotone band.
findings.candidate: Candidate testimonial cards render the star row in violet on the white cards, softening the signature warm accent in the quote cards.
findings.direction: Set testimonial star icons to #F59E0B (gold) at 14px within the white quote cards, keeping the rest of the card violet accents unchanged.

visual.summary: The candidate is a strong realization of the reference design thesis: violet/lilac palette, photographic hero with dark overlay and single pill CTA, icon-chip card grids, violet collapsed FAQ bars with a white expanded item, duotone photographic testimonial band with overlapping white quote cards, and the black contact CTA block with violet ribbon and floating white contact strip card are all faithfully reproduced, with correct kicker pills, rounded cards, hairline borders and soft shadows throughout. Typography matches the geometric-sans character with bold near-black headlines and restrained body copy. Mobile preserves the design language with stacked splits, hamburger nav and single-column cards. The most impactful gaps are the missing dark rounded hero content panel, the absent client-logo marquee band under the hero, missing floating metric cards on the Why Us photo tile, the missing full-width split card in the services grid, and the gold-vs-violet star rows in testimonials. All are localized, cosmetic repairs that do not affect structure.
